Class PostgreSQLBroker

java.lang.Object
com.saicone.delivery4j.Broker
com.saicone.delivery4j.PlainTextBroker
com.saicone.delivery4j.broker.PostgreSQLBroker
Direct Known Subclasses:
PostgreSQLHikariBroker
public class PostgreSQLBroker extends PlainTextBroker
PostgreSQL broker implementation to send data using LISTEN and NOTIFY statements.

Is this scalable?
No
Allows large messages?
No
Should I use it?
Maybe

      public void setTimeout(long time, @NotNull @NotNull TimeUnit unit)
      Set timeout that will be used to listen for new notifications from database, this is the maximum communication delay between applications.
      By default, 5 seconds is used.
      Parameters:
      time - the delay between listen execution.
      unit - the unit that time is expressed in.
